title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Officers
tiers.description: Each director or company secretary of Service Stream or any of its subsidiaries.

tiers.name: Employees
tiers.description: Each full-time, part-time or casual employee of Service Stream or any of its subsidiaries.

tiers.name: Designated Person
tiers.description: Any Officer; the Chief Executive Officer; an Employee who reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer; or an Employee who, as a consequence of their role, permanently has access to confidential or price sensitive information regarding the company's outlook or prospects. Subject to the closed period, margin loan, short selling, stock lending, hedging and permission-to-trade restrictions in section 4.

tiers.name: Chairman
tiers.description: The Designated Person who chairs the Board; distinguished only for the permission-to-trade approver under 4.8.

tiers.name: Director, CEO or Company Secretary
tiers.description: Designated Persons who are a Director, the Chief Executive Officer, or Company Secretary (other than the Chairman); obtain permission to trade from the Chairman.

tiers.name: Other Designated Person
tiers.description: Any other Designated Person (e.g. a CEO direct report, or an employee with permanent access to price sensitive information who is not an Officer); obtains permission to trade from the CEO and Company Secretary.

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: Immediate family members (spouse, de facto partner, dependent child or parents), and companies, trusts, superannuation funds and other entities the Designated Person controls.

definitions.hedging_definition: to hedge their existing holdings of or entitlements to Service Stream securities

windows.end_anchor: 24 hours after the half-year or full-year financial results of Service Stream (as the case may be) are released to ASX

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may notify Designated Persons that any additional period is also a Closed Period, for example while relying on a continuous disclosure exception; the Policy does not state whether such additional periods are announced or kept confidential.

rules.detail: Absolute, all-times ban, not limited to Closed Periods; the general 'Deal' definition does not itself mention derivatives, but section 4.5 expressly extends the short selling/stock lending/hedging prohibitions to derivatives over the shares, catching an OTC put and call directly.
rules.evidence: These prohibitions also include derivatives on the Service Stream securities.

rules.detail: Section 4's derivatives, hedging and margin loan bans are additional obligations that apply only to Designated Persons; an Officer or Employee who is not a Designated Person is subject only to the general insider trading prohibition in section 2 when in possession of Price Sensitive Information.
rules.evidence: This policy also sets out additional obligations that apply if you are a Designated Person as per sections 3 and 4.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging existing holdings or entitlements, at all times, not limited to Closed Periods and with no clearance route (the 4.7 clearance only overrides the Closed Period restriction, not this substantive ban).
rules.evidence: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into agreements or other arrangements: ... to hedge their existing holdings of or entitlements to Service Stream securities.

rules.detail: Not restricted for Officers/Employees who are not Designated Persons.
rules.evidence: This policy also sets out additional obligations that apply if you are a Designated Person as per sections 3 and 4.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named and is not banned outright like hedging or margin loans. A prepaid forward or similar arrangement is an agreement to dispose of securities and so a 'Dealing', requiring the Dealing be outside a Closed Period (or exempt/cleared), permission to trade under 4.8, and no Price Sensitive Information.
rules.evidence: Deal or Dealing in securities ... extends to applying for, acquiring, or disposing of, securities or entering into an agreement to do any of those things.

rules.detail: For non-Designated Officers/Employees a monetisation agreement is a Dealing subject only to the general insider trading ban when Price Sensitive Information is held; no permission or clearance step applies.
rules.evidence: extends to applying for, acquiring, or disposing of, securities or entering into an agreement to do any of those things

rules.detail: Absolute ban, at all times, no clearance route.
rules.evidence: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into agreements or other arrangements: ... to short sell Service Stream securities

rules.detail: Absolute ban, at all times, no clearance route.
rules.evidence: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into agreements or other arrangements: ... for stock lending in relation to Service Stream securities

rules.detail: Not named individually, but a CFD is a derivative on the shares and is expressly caught by the derivatives extension to the section 4.5 prohibitions.
rules.evidence: These prohibitions also include derivatives on the Service Stream securities.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on entering into or maintaining a margin loan over Service Stream securities, justified expressly by the risk of a forced sale breaching the Policy; no clearance route.
rules.evidence: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into or maintaining margin loan arrangements over Service Stream securities due to the risk of forced sale of those securities, in breach of this policy.

rules.detail: Only 'margin loan arrangements' are expressly banned (4.4); a charge, lien or pledge granted otherwise than under a margin loan structure is not separately named, and the general Deal definition does not cover encumbrance.
Only margin loan arrangements are named; the Policy does not address other forms of secured financing (e.g. a collar-linked loan not structured as a margin loan) either way.
rules.evidence: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into or maintaining margin loan arrangements over Service Stream securities due to the risk of forced sale of those securities, in breach of this policy.

rules.detail: Speculative or short-term buying and selling is banned outright; no defined holding period.
rules.evidence: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into agreements or other arrangements: to speculative trade or buy and sell shares on a short-term basis

clearance.evidence: The Chairman must obtain permission from either the Lead Independent Director or the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee ... that Dealing must be completed within 14 calendar days from the date of the approval, or such earlier time as determined.

A Director, Chief Executive Officer, and Company Secretary must obtain permission from the Chairman. ... that Dealing must be completed within 14 calendar days from the date of the approval, or such earlier time as determined.

clearance.approver: Chief Executive Officer and Company Secretary
clearance.evidence: Each other Designated Person must obtain permission from the Chief Executive Officer and Company Secretary. ... that Dealing must be completed within 14 calendar days from the date of the approval, or such earlier time as determined.

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee, if the Chairman is the applicant), through the Company Secretary
exceptions.evidence: A clearance will only be granted where the Designated Person is experiencing severe personal hardship or another exceptional circumstance; and the Designated Person is not in possession of any price sensitive information affecting the relevant Service Stream securities.

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee, if the Chairman is the applicant), through the Company Secretary

exceptions.evidence: There may be instances of transactions being allowed under this section even if they occur during a Closed Period. Where this is the case the Chairman will notify the relevant Officers and Employees.

exemption_authority: Chairman (or, if the Chairman is the person concerned, the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee) grants Closed Period clearance for severe personal hardship or another exceptional circumstance, through the Company Secretary; the Chairman alone may declare a transaction exempt under 4.6.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Persons may only Deal in Service Stream Securities if: (a) the Dealing is outside a Closed Period ... or you have obtained clearance ...; (b) you have obtained the relevant permission to trade ...; and (c) you do not possess any Price Sensitive Information
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even where a Dealing is not independently banned, it needs both Closed Period clearance (hardship/exceptional circumstance only) and routine permission to trade; but derivatives, hedging and margin loans are separately and absolutely banned by 4.4/4.5, so neither gate can cure those bans for a collar.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into agreements or other arrangements ... to hedge their existing holdings of or entitlements to Service Stream securities. These prohibitions also include derivatives on the Service Stream securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is a blanket, all-times, no-exception ban on hedging and derivatives, including an OTC put and call, for every director, the CEO, CEO direct reports and any employee with permanent price-sensitive-information access; there is no clearance mechanism that reaches this substantive prohibition.

bespoke_clauses.topic: margin loan ban tied to forced-sale risk
bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Persons are prohibited from entering into or maintaining margin loan arrangements over Service Stream securities due to the risk of forced sale of those securities, in breach of this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A bank loan secured on the collared shares, if structured as a margin loan, is permanently prohibited for Designated Persons with no carve-out; a facility not structured as a margin loan is not expressly addressed, but the stated rationale (forced-sale risk) would apply equally to it.

bespoke_clauses.topic: directors and company secretaries are automatically Designated Persons
bespoke_clauses.clause: A Designated Person is any Officer; the Chief Executive Officer; an Employee who reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer; or an Employee who ... permanently has access to confidential or price sensitive information
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Every director and company secretary is caught by the absolute hedging/derivatives/margin-loan bans as a matter of definition; there is no route for a director to fall outside Designated Person status.

summary: A funded collar is not available under this Policy for a director, the CEO, or any other Designated Person: section 4.5 imposes an absolute, all-times prohibition on hedging existing holdings or entitlements and expressly extends that prohibition to derivatives, so both the purchased put and written call legs of an OTC collar are banned outright, with no clearance mechanism reaching that substantive ban (the only clearance under 4.7 relieves the Closed Period timing restriction, not the hedging or margin-loan prohibitions). A bank loan secured on the collared shares is separately and permanently banned to the extent it is structured as a margin loan under section 4.4; the Policy is silent on other forms of secured financing. Because every director and company secretary is automatically a Designated Person (as are the CEO, CEO direct reports, and anyone with permanent access to price sensitive information), essentially the entire population a bank would target for a funded collar is caught by these absolute bans. Only Officers or Employees who fall outside the Designated Person definition are free of these restrictions, subject only to the general insider trading prohibition when holding Price Sensitive Information, and no exemption authority exists to waive the hedging, derivatives or margin loan bans for anyone else.
